chapters.label: Stuttgart, 2024
chapters.text: Stuttgart, 2024. Spain against Germany, one all, the last minute of extra time. Dani Olmo clips in a cross... Mikel Merino heads it in! Spain win!

chapters.label: Watch his run
chapters.text: Watch again. Merino waits outside the box. Every defender watches the ball. Then he runs in late, and jumps!

chapters.label: Like his dad
chapters.text: From behind the goal: a twist of the neck, past Manuel Neuer! Merino circles the corner flag, like his dad did here in 1991.

chapters.label: Arrive late
chapters.text: Arrive late! Defenders watch the ball and forget the midfielder. Wait, then run into the gap, or the back post!
